claims.text: Large Language Models are prone to generating hallucinations in their responses.
MetaQA is a self-contained hallucination detection approach that leverages metamorphic relations and prompt mutation.
MetaQA operates without any external resources.
MetaQA is compatible with both open-source and closed-source LLMs.
MetaQA achieves a precision superiority margin ranging from 0.041 to 0.113 over SelfCheckGPT across four evaluated LLMs.
MetaQA achieves a recall superiority margin ranging from 0.143 to 0.430 over SelfCheckGPT across four evaluated LLMs.
MetaQA achieves an F1-score superiority margin ranging from 0.154 to 0.368 over SelfCheckGPT across four evaluated LLMs.
MetaQA achieves an average F1-score of 0.435 on Mistral-7B compared to SelfCheckGPT's F1-score of 0.205.

evidence.description: Large Language Models (LLMs) are prone to hallucinations, e.g., factually incorrect information, in their responses.
This paper presents MetaQA, a self-contained hallucination detection approach that leverages metamorphic relation and prompt mutation.
Unlike existing methods, MetaQA operates without any external resources
and is compatible with both open-source and closed-source LLMs.
MetaQA outperforms SelfCheckGPT with a superiority margin ranging from 0.041 - 0.113 (for precision)
MetaQA outperforms SelfCheckGPT with a superiority margin ranging from 0.143 - 0.430 (for recall)
MetaQA outperforms SelfCheckGPT with a superiority margin ranging from 0.154 - 0.368 (for F1-score)
For instance, with Mistral-7B, MetaQA achieves an average F1-score of 0.435, compared to SelfCheckGPT’s F1-score of 0.205, representing an improvement rate of 112.2%.

limitations.text: Existing hallucination detection methods primarily depend on external resources, which can suffer from issues such as low availability, incomplete coverage, privacy concerns, high latency, low reliability, and poor scalability.
Existing hallucination detection methods depending on output probabilities are often inaccessible for closed-source LLMs like GPT models.
